components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      type: object
      properties:
        content:

## Summary

I implemented create-time telephone normalization for `POST /api/owners` so the raw input is stripped of every non-digit character and must reduce to exactly 10 digits, else a 400 is returned.

**The problem:** The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` carried `@Pattern("^[0-9]*$")` (from the OpenAPI spec), so a formatted number like `(04) 1234-5678` was rejected with 400 by Bean Validation *before* any normalization could run. Normalization therefore had to be paired with relaxing that DTO constraint.

**Changes, each in its own small unit:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — removed the digits-only `pattern` from `OwnerFields.telephone` (keeping `minLength`/`maxLength`) so formatted input reaches the application layer; updated the field description to document the new rule. The DTO is regenerated from this at build time.

2. **`TelephoneNormalizer`** (new `@Component` in `rest.validation`) — single responsibility: strip non-digits (`\D`) and require exactly 10, returning the canonical value or throwing.

3. **`InvalidTelephoneException`** (new) — signals the 10-digit rule failure, carrying the rejected input.

4. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — new handler mapping `InvalidTelephoneException` to a **400** with the existing `ValidationErrorsResponse` shape (`errors: ["telephone"]`), mirroring the existing `MissingOwnerFieldsException` handler.

5. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — injected the normalizer and normalize the mapped owner's telephone before saving, so the stored/returned value is the 10-digit form.

The existing `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")`/`@Digits` on the `Owner` entity remain as defense-in-depth and pass cleanly for normalized values. I scoped the change to create only, as the specification states.
